personality: 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal LIGHT (Modified with clean sans-serif typography for an Editorial feel)
personality_one_liner: A calming, sophisticated, and restorative companion that guides gently without pressure.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial spacing. Use xl/2xl to create restorative breathing room. Never cram elements. Whitespace is used intentionally to avoid overwhelming the patient.

do's: Use only on sticky bottom tab bar and sticky headers to maintain a clean editorial feel.
Ensure text on glass has a translucent tinted base underneath (≥70% of surface) for readability.
dont's: Never use on general cards or lists.
Avoid heavy blur that creates a tech/dashboard aesthetic; keep it extremely subtle.

screens.name: Landing
screens.purpose: Introduce AMODO warmly and direct users to select their role.

states.loading: Centered gentle spinner in brand primary.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Typographic 'amodo' logo centered. Bottom 1/3 contains welcoming text and two primary CTAs (Soy Paciente / Soy Acompañante) pinned to bottom safe area.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Gather context without pressure through a step-by-step calming flow.
screens.layout: One question per screen. Generous top padding. Questions in display 2xl. Options presented as large, softly rounded 'surfaceTertiary' chips. Sticky 'Continuar' button at bottom. Subtle progress bar at top.

screens.name: Patient Home (Mi Día)
screens.purpose: Provide a gentle daily summary, quick actions, and shared agenda without gamified pressure.

states.empty: Abstract soft texture with 'Tu día está libre hoy' text.

screens.layout: Top section features a textured abstract sage banner (20% opacity) behind a personal greeting and 'Mi Día' summary card. Below: 'Señales rápidas' (Quick Signals) as a horizontal scroll of rounded, softly tinted containers (lavender, sage, coral). Bottom list of treatments and pending tasks using hairline dividers instead of heavy cards. No streaks or gamification elements.

screens.name: Kit Builder
screens.purpose: Editorial-style e-commerce flow for building care kits.

states.empty: Illustration/Image of empty bag with 'Empieza a crear tu kit'.

screens.layout: High-contrast editorial grid. Products float on '#F5F5F2' background with no heavy borders. Large, art-directed images. Categories as pill filters at the top. Cart/Checkout handled via a sticky bottom sheet over a blurred background.

screens.name: Caregiver Home
screens.purpose: Centralized overview of the patient's well-being and shared tasks.

states.empty: No linked patients state with an 'Invitar paciente' button.

screens.layout: Linked patient selector at top. Clear, actionable summary of 'Requests Received' (Señales rápidas) in a dedicated surfaceSecondary card block. Below, a shared agenda view listing upcoming treatments and expenses (Gastos) using standard list rows with clear typographic hierarchy.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the selected color palette: no blues, purples, or typical 'medical' colors. Use the provided sage green, lavender, and soft coral strategically.
Implement zero shadows (shadow_tier: 0). Use the contrast between '#F5F5F2' (background) and '#FFFFFF' (surfaces) to create depth. Ensure hairline dividers are used instead of heavy borders.
The UI must feel restorative, not clinical or gamified. Do not implement streaks, aggressive notifications, or anything that induces guilt.
For the Kit Builder, adopt an editorial minimalist e-commerce approach. Products should float on the background without bounding boxes.
Typography must be highly legible. Use Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and DM Sans for body text.
Apply gradient-to-dark scrims over hero/background images if text is overlaid, ensuring readability.
Use Phosphor line icons consistently. Avoid standard medical crosses or overly literal medical icons.
